claim_boundary: sanitized readiness observations only; no determination of compromise, root cause, attribution, or absence of compromise

control_observations.summary: The named incident boundary and affected environment were represented without customer identifiers.
Event-time references and ordering controls were represented without raw logs or identifiers.
Preservation owner, retention reference, and hash-ready evidence handling were represented.
Containment decision points and rollback boundaries were represented without changing the environment.
Stakeholder roles, escalation paths, and update cadence were represented without personal data.
